name: line-diff
title: Side-by-side line diff
description: Each line on the left side-by-side with the right, grouped by parent record. Differing cells are tinted on both sides, and missing lines show as gaps.
needs: Records grouped by a parent entity with comparable fields.

text.title: {left} against {right}
text.lede: Each {unitOne} on the left beside the corresponding line on the right. Cells that differ are tinted on both sides; a line that exists on one side only leaves a gap on the other.

options.name: sortBy
options.description: Order of groups in the list: input order, or groups with breaks first.
